entries.title: Inflation is back above the 2% target
entries.what: Euro area HICP, % change on a year earlier
entries.caveats: Flash estimate for the latest month (flag e).

entries.title: Energy is doing most of the pushing
entries.what: Contributions to euro area HICP inflation, percentage points
entries.transform: Each component's annual rate multiplied by its weight in the basket, so the parts add up to the total (small rounding gaps possible).

entries.title: Prices are rising faster almost everywhere
entries.what: HICP, % change on a year earlier, by country
entries.caveats: Colours centre on the ECB's 2% target. Latest month is a flash estimate.

entries.title: Inflation at a glance
entries.what: Euro area HICP and components, % change on a year earlier
entries.transform: Latest published value, the one before it and the same period a year earlier.

entries.title: The economy is still growing, slowly
entries.what: Euro area real GDP, % change
entries.transform: Bars: change on the previous period. Line: change on the same period a year earlier.
entries.caveats: Chain-linked volumes, seasonally and calendar adjusted.

entries.title: Households are carrying the recovery
entries.what: Contributions to quarterly euro area GDP growth, percentage points
entries.transform: Each component's annual rate multiplied by its weight in the basket, so the parts add up to the total (small rounding gaps possible).
entries.caveats: 2020 swings are clipped at plus and minus 2 points to keep recent quarters readable.

entries.title: Spain keeps outgrowing the big three
entries.what: Real GDP, % change on a year earlier
entries.transform: Shown as published, one panel per country on a shared scale.
entries.caveats: Pandemic quarters fall outside the shared scale.

entries.title: Unemployment has stopped falling
entries.what: Unemployment rate, % of the labour force, seasonally adjusted

entries.title: Fewer vacancies, same unemployment
entries.what: Job vacancy rate against the unemployment rate, quarterly, %

entries.title: The labour market at a glance
